## Description
AEDIX develops AI solutions customized for Italian SMEs. We specialize in:
- **SaaS platforms** for vertical sectors (construction, retail, hospitality)
- **AI agents** for business automation, customer service, content generation
- **Performance marketing** with measurable ROI
- **Custom software development** and system integration

## Core Products
1. **Edilizia in Cloud** — Cloud construction management platform
   - URL: https://www.ediliziaincloud.com
   - Features: Job costing, quotations, electronic invoicing (SDI), mobile app, team management
   - Target: Construction companies 5–50 employees
   - Status: Active & Production

2. **Marketing Services** — Performance marketing for SMEs
   - Google Ads, LinkedIn, B2B lead generation
   - Consultation & strategy
